storyCards.headline: Sundown: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Gordon Lightfoot's "Sundown" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Sundown" is a song by Canadian folk artist Gordon Lightfoot, from the titular album, released as a single in March 1974.

"Sundown" reached number one on the U.S.

Billboard Hot 100 and easy listening charts and number 13 on the Hot Country singles chart, as well as number one in Canada on RPM's national singles chart.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.
